claim_boundary: fresh-seed confirmation of one descriptive carrier endpoint metric; no route, causal, routing, adaptation, or learning claim
fitting_boundary: Fit decoder, projections, normalization and carrier tracker only on base-order train32; apply unchanged to paired eval32 in both primary arms.
outcome_check: per-seed median delay8 base-minus-upstream true R2 > 0 across fixed projections 17,29,43
confirmation_gate: Confirm only if the carrier residual contrast is negative in at least 5/6 fresh seeds and the decoding outcome check is positive in at least 5/6 fresh seeds. Otherwise retain no confirmed metric.
